title: Export time and memory
definitions: `smp` is the sample project's command-line tool. The index is the JSON file of records that `smp import` writes. The reference machine has 4 CPU cores and 8 GiB of memory. Peak resident memory is the `maximum resident set size` that `/usr/bin/time -v` reports.
must: `smp export` MUST finish within 2 seconds of wall time for an index of 10,000 records on the reference machine.
must_not: `smp export` MUST NOT exceed 512 MiB of peak resident memory for an index of 10,000 records.
rationale: Exports run as one step of the pre-merge check, and each step has a 2-second budget on the reference machine.
acceptance_criteria: Exporting a generated 10,000-record index on the reference machine takes less than 2 seconds of wall time.
`/usr/bin/time -v smp export` on the same index reports a maximum resident set size below 512 MiB.
